name: Dragon Knight boat-sergeant
description: Sergeant Harl Brenn, the existing Dragon Knight boat-sergeant Halla knocked into the canal at the Watercrafters guild stair. Adult human; clipped orders, led three other soldiers trying to commandeer the hired skiff carrying Torval crew and tools. Name supplied by colleague Drell, no new prior encounter or current whereabouts asserted.

physical_state.position: accompanying Ward from shore camp toward Crown boat
physical_state.rescue: completed by own Brawn assisted by two companions; rolled89 Easy90 success
physical_state.note: Recovered uninjured in original scene; ordinary return to company quarters after guild-stair detail. No carried-over soaked status days later.

extras.luck_policy: PC-only campaign rule: NPCs have no Luck pool or Luck rank bonuses; never spend Luck for NPC rerolls, reversals or damage mitigation.
extras.identity_note: Existing session1 boat-sergeant, NOT a new person and NOT Drell. Name learned by Halla from Drell d3/night; face confirmation on seeing him remains useful.
extras.current_weapon_stowage: Sword belt and round shield voluntarily left with shore company at own tent before accompanying Ward.

doing.goal: Withdraw with Hanzo's household; Purewater chapter closed.
doing.next: Remain offstage pending a newly authorised adventure.

actor_notes: LOOKS: Adult human sergeant in mail, sword belted, round shield near hand. CORE: Transport detail soldier accustomed to being obeyed because his lord's colours stand behind him. NATURE: Clipped orders, little patience for civilians interrupting military work. WANTS: Finish transport duties without being made a fool of again. PRESSURE: Falls back on rank, witnesses and company solidarity; does not volunteer a suicidal attack on Crown soldiers. EDGE: Led three soldiers at Torval hired-skiff attempted seizure; Halla kicked him into canal, no injury. Harl Brenn not Drell; no automatic knowledge of night arrests.
